transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: Good afternoon and welcome to the first showing of the Tessaline 58 here at the harbour festival.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: My name is Corvin Aldmere. I am a broker with Harbourline Yachts, the Tessaline dealer for the North Sea.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: So let's start with the numbers everybody asks about. The length overall is fifty eight feet.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: The beam is a little over sixteen and a half feet, which gives you a very wide saloon.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: We carry just under two hundred and fifty gallons of fresh water on board.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: The fuel tank takes about seven hundred gallons, so the range is serious.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: She has twin engines at eight hundred horsepower each.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: Cruising speed is twenty six knots and the top speed is up to thirty two knots.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: Down below there are three cabins and two heads for the owner and the guests.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: The swim platform lowers right into the water, so it doubles as a staircase and a tender ramp.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: The tender garage takes a three metre jet tender with room to spare.

transcript.speaker: SPEAKER_1
transcript.text: If you have any questions, just email me or leave a comment below this video.

key_facts: The Tessaline 58 is shown for the first time at the harbour festival
The swim platform lowers into the water and doubles as a staircase and tender ramp
The tender garage takes a three metre jet tender
There are three cabins and two heads below deck
